kdri.edition: 2025 한국인 영양소 섭취기준 (보건복지부·한국영양학회), published 2025-12-31; 국문요약본 (발간등록번호 11-1352000-100416-13). Errata (1st–3rd, 2026-02-02/02-27/03-16) checked: no change to any value used here.
kdri.verification: Values read from summary tables pp.xii, xv–xvii, xix–xx (PDF pages 12,15–17,19–20), both visually and by coordinate text extraction; 2020 values from the appendix table in the same PDF (pp.137–141).

vitaminD.note: 충분섭취량(AI); no RNI set. 65+ AI is 15 µg (same as 2020). Summary table p.xv (PDF p.15).

magnesium.note: UL 350 mg applies ONLY to non-food sources (supplements/medicines) — table column '식품 외 급원 상한섭취량'; endpoint diarrhoea. 2020 men 30+ RNI was 370 → 380 in 2025. p.xix.

iron.note: 2025 lowered adult RNIs vs 2020 (2020: men 10/10/10/9/9, women 14/14/8/8/7). UL endpoint GI discomfort. p.xx.

calcium.note: 2025 UL is sex-specific and changes at age 30 (2020 UL was 2,500 for 19-49 and 2,000 for 50+, both sexes). 2020 RNI: men 800/800/750/700/700, women 700/700/800/800/800. p.xix.

vitaminB12.note: No UL set in KDRI (blank in table, 2020 and 2025). p.xvii.

vitaminB6.note: UL lowered from 100 mg (2020) to 50 mg (2025) due to peripheral neuropathy reports at ≤50 mg. p.xvii.

folate.note: RNI is in µg DFE; UL (1,000) is in µg/day of folic acid from fortified foods and supplements only, not DFE. Women of childbearing age: 400 µg/day folic acid supplement recommended. p.xvii.

epaDha.note: EPA+DHA 충분섭취량 250 mg for all adult bands; no UL set. Pregnant/lactating 300 (DHA 200) total. p.xii.

alphaLinolenicAcid.note: Plant n-3 (ALA) AI; no UL. p.xii.

mismatches: Vitamin D: app says AI 10 µg — true only for ages 19–64. KDRI 2025 (and 2020) AI is 15 µg for 65–74 and 75+ (both sexes). UL 100 µg matches.

Calcium UL by age: KDRI 2025 changed the bands. 2025: men 19–29 = 3,000, men 30+ = 2,500 (incl. 50+, 65+); women 19–29 = 2,500, women 30+ = 2,000. 2020 was 2,500 (19–49) / 2,000 (50+) for both sexes. If the app uses the 2020 pattern, it is wrong for 2025 in three places: men 19–29 (2,500→3,000), men 50+ (2,000→2,500), women 30–49 (2,500→2,000). App's exact calcium figures were not given to me, so please compare.

Not a mismatch, but changed in 2025 (check any RNI text in the app): iron RNI lowered (men 19–74: 10/9 → 8, men 75+: 9 → 7; women 19–49: 14 → 12, 50–64: 8 → 7, 65–74: 8 → 6, 75+: 7 → 6); calcium RNI men 50–64 750 → 800, men 65+ 700 → 800, women 19–49 700 → 650, women 50+ 800 → 750; magnesium RNI men 30+ 370 → 380.
confirmedMatches: Iron UL 45 mg (all adult bands) — matches.
Vitamin C RNI 100 mg / UL 2,000 mg — matches (all adult bands, both sexes).
Vitamin B6 UL 50 mg (2025) and 100 mg (2020) — both match.
